title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on.

Who We Want

An experienced Data Engineer.
You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself.

Strong in SQL and dbt.
You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation.

At home in the Cloud.
You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine.

Reliability-minded.
You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you.

Curious about the business.
You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus.

Who We Don’t Want

Pure dashboard builder.
You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from.

Pure pipeline plumber.
You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them.

Over-engineer.
You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it.

Remote-only operator.
You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office.

Our Data Stack

  • Warehouse: AWS Redshift
  • Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python
  • Transformation: dbt
  • Orchestration: Dagster
  • Reverse ETL: Hightouch
  • BI: Metabase
  • Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions

Your Day To Day

  • Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't.
  • Design and build the dbt models that take raw data to gold tables, with clear layers, naming and documentation that the Business Analyst and the rest of the company can rely on.
  • Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours.
  • Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request.
  • Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer.
  • Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
  • Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in.

Why People Choose Us

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics

Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable

Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline

Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup

Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. At Superchat, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously.

Relocating to Berlin? We support you with practical relocation help. You'll feel home in no time.

We look forward to your application!

  • Unterstütze übergreifende Anforderungen im Gebäude, indem du bei Bedarf Community-Aufgaben übernimmst und mit Sales, Account Management und anderen internen Teams koordinierst.

Teamführung:

  • Führe und unterstütze die Gebäudeteams, indem du ein starkes Onboarding sicherstellst, ihnen die benötigten Tools zur Verfügung stellst und eine ausgewogene Präsenz über mehrere Standorte hinweg sicherstellst.

  • Unterstütze die Erstellung monatlicher, vierteljährlicher und jährlicher Budgets und überprüfe regelmäßig die finanzielle Leistung des Gebäudes, um Bereiche für effizientere Ausgaben und operative Verbesserungen zu identifizieren.

About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

You know you will be successful when:

  • You accurately recognize the key needs of companies and confidently guide them to effective solutions as a reliable partner.

  • You know what your community loves and put together programs that you enjoy and are proud of (you even post about it on Instagram!)

You are a great fit for this role if:

  • You draw energy from working with people and act as a strong team player.

We are the number one dating affiliate business in the world, and this role sits at the center of it. You will run paid social for the dating vertical together with our media buying lead.

  • Build the creative: ad angles, hooks, advertorials and full ad concepts - researched from the customer's problem, produced with your own hands and with AI, and shipped as a constant flow of tests.

  • Launchnew channels: TikTok, YouTube Ads and/or other creative-heavy platforms, taken from zero to profitability.

Beyond our own sites, We Love X constantly incubates new, performance-marketing-driven business models – from first idea to international scale.

title: Werkstudent Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d)
description:
Wir stellen uns dir vor.

Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Was wie eine klassische mittelständische Steuerberatungs- und Rechtsanwaltsgesellschaft klingen mag, ist bei genauerem Betrachten vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir sehen den Menschen vor den Zahlen, denken und handeln fortschrittlich und arbeiten kontinuierlich daran, uns als Kanzlei und Arbeitgeber sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln.

Dass wir dafür auch einen Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) suchen, mag für eine Steuerkanzlei zunächst ungewöhnlich erscheinen. Für uns ist es allerdings der nächste logische Schritt. Schließlich möchten wir die Digitalisierung unserer Kanzlei aktiv vorantreiben, bestehende Prozesse verbessern und neue technische Möglichkeiten im Bereich KI sinnvoll in unseren Arbeitsalltag integrieren.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, digitale Anwendungen weiterzuentwickeln und eigene Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Natürlich sind auch wir nicht perfekt. Wir geben jedoch jeden Tag unser Bestes, um für dich einen optimalen Arbeitsort zu schaffen.

Dein individuelles Tätigkeitsprofil.

Du interessierst dich für IT und möchtest mit deiner Arbeit tatsächlich etwas bewegen? Bei uns kannst du die technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Kanzlei aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass digitale Anwendungen im Arbeitsalltag reibungslos funktionieren. Dabei kümmerst du dich sowohl um unsere bestehende IT-Landschaft als auch um die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen, mit denen wir wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisieren und unsere Prozesse effizienter gestalten.

Konkret erwarten dich folgende Tätigkeitsbereiche:

  • Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne IT-Themen und Unterstützung unserer Mitarbeiter bei Anwendungsfragen

  • Koordination und Zusammenarbeit mit unserem externen IT-Dienstleister

  • Analyse, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung technischer Probleme

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung, insbesondere Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive

  • Einführung neuer Anwendungen sowie Dokumentation unserer IT-Systeme und Prozesse

  • Analyse und Optimierung manueller sowie wiederkehrender Geschäftsprozesse

  • Entwicklung und Betreuung automatisierter Workflows mit Power Automate

  • Erstellung kleiner interner Anwendungen mit Power Apps

  • Anbindung von Fachanwendungen über Schnittstellen wie REST-APIs, HTTP, JSON und Connectoren

  • Datenverarbeitung und -aufbereitung mit Excel und Power Query

Unsere Wünsche an dich.

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits jedes Programm beherrschst oder mit sämtlichen Technologien gearbeitet hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis mitbringst, dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest und Freude daran hast, eigenständig Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schließlich verändert sich die IT-Welt ständig und wir möchten uns gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln.

Von den folgenden Punkten solltest du dich ebenfalls angesprochen fühlen:

  • Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder bist in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Systeme, digitale Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge

  • Microsoft 365 ist dir vertraut und idealerweise hast du dich bereits mit Power Automate, Power Apps oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen beschäftigt

  • Begriffe wie APIs, JSON oder Power Query sind dir bekannt und du hast Interesse daran, dein Wissen in diesen Bereichen zu vertiefen

  • Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung

  • Teamzusammenhalt ist dir wichtig und du hast Freude daran, andere Mitarbeiter bei technischen Fragen zu unterstützen

Das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

Ein Arbeitsverhältnis ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Deshalb kannst du dich bei uns auf weit mehr als ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis freuen:

  • Gelebte Flexibilität mit Home-Office und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Mentale Gesundheitsförderung mit vielschichtigen Unterstützungsangeboten und zusätzlich bis zu 12 Coaching- oder Therapiestunden pro Jahr

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch einen engagierten Ansprechpartner

  • Regelmäßiges Feedback zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung

  • Klare Strukturen gepaart mit digitalen und standardisierten Prozessen

  • Vertrauen und Freiraum für ein eigenständiges Arbeiten

  • Weiterbildungsflatrate

  • Nettolohnoptimierung mit 50 Euro Sachbezugsgutscheinen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Kindergartenzuschuss, Bike-Leasing etc.

  • Business-Englisch und einmal pro Woche ein Fitnessangebot

  • Höhenverstellbare Tische und klimatisierte Räumlichkeiten

  • Beste technische Hard- und Software-Ausstattung (Notebook, Geschäftshandy etc.)

  • Support durch einen kompetenten externen IT-Systempartner

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und vieles mehr

You know how field co-sell actually works, not just the theory

  • Working knowledge of the SI ecosystem: relationships with practice leads and client partners at GSIs and RSIs, and an understanding of how SIs build practices, attach services to software ARR, and allocate delivery capacity

  • A builder mindset: experience creating co-sell and SI motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.

This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.

You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. The AE continues to own the account and the relationship. Your job is to make sure we win the deal and that it's structured to set us and the customer up for long-term success.

The work doesn't stop at one deal. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.

This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

In this role you will

  • Lead strategic deals. Own the pursuit strategy for our largest and most complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with account teams from qualification through close. Help decide which pursuits warrant this level of investment and where your time goes.

  • Build executive engagement. Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.

  • Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.

  • Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.

  • Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines.

  • Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment.

  • Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big.

  • Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions.

  • Deep deal structuring experience. You have personally designed and negotiated creative commercial structures and know how to make the economics work for both sides while protecting the business.

  • Executive presence. You are credible with C-suite executives at the largest enterprises in the world and can hold the room alongside our CRO and CEO.

  • Comfort outside the playbook. You thrive in deals that don't follow a standard process, and you know when to break the playbook and when to rely on it.

  • Cross-functional orchestration. You can rally Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and executives around a deal when none of them report to you, and you do it by being prepared, decisive, and easy to work with.

  • Business case and value fluency. You can build a credible, quantified business case tied to customer outcomes and defend it to a CFO.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You understand pricing, margin, and long-term account economics, and you know the difference between a big deal and a good deal.

  • Technical fluency. You understand AI and platform products well enough to shape solution design and hold your own with a customer's CTO.

  • Operator mentality. You care about what happens after signature, and you make sure what we sold gets deployed successfully.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable leading pursuits with teams and customers across AMER, EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and India.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 40% of the time, often with customers' and ElevenLabs' executives.

Bonus points

  • Experience selling AI, voice, conversational AI, or platform/API products to large enterprises.

  • Experience structuring partnerships, marketplace, or co-sell agreements alongside direct deals.

  • Experience in a company where the product and the market move weekly and deals have to keep up.

Location

This is a remote global role within the Revenue organization. You will travel up to 50% for

customer and executive meetings and for working sessions with regional sales leadership.

description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.

ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.

What the job involves

Roadmap ownership

  • Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

  • Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

  • Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

  • Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

Discovery and definition

  • Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

  • Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

  • Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

Product operations and delivery

  • Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

  • Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

  • Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

Technical and data judgement

  • Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

  • Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

  • Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

Research, validation and data

  • Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

  • Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

  • Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

  • Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

  • For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

  • Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

Working with AI: Co-Analyst

  • Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

  • Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

  • Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

Raising the bar for product practice

  • Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

  • Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas.

  • Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery.

  • Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions.

  • Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication.

You should apply if

  • You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value.

  • You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore.

  • You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call.

  • You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating.

Votre mission : contribuer à un objectif exclusif de prévention et de préservation de la santé et de la sécurité au travail, en accompagnant nos entreprises adhérentes sur l’évaluation, la hiérarchisation et la réduction des risques professionnels.

🧭 Parmi vos responsabilités

  • Réaliser des Actions en Milieu de Travail (AMT) : visites/observations en entreprise, études de postes, recueil d’informations (activité, effectifs, organisation, postes, procédés, produits, équipements, expositions, AT/MP, etc.).

  • Formuler des recommandations de prévention en privilégiant la logique : supprimer → substituer → protections collectives → organisation.

  • Aider à construire et prioriser un plan d’actions réaliste (court/moyen terme) adapté aux moyens de l’entreprise, puis en suivre la mise en œuvre (indicateurs, amélioration continue).

  • Conduire des sensibilisations et formations (sécurité, thématiques prévention).

  • Contribuer aux actions collectives du SPSTI : campagnes de prévention, ateliers, webinaires, retours d’expérience.

  • Orienter vers des ressources externes si nécessaire (CARSAT/CRAMIF, INRS, ANACT/ARACT, inspection du travail, organismes de contrôle, consultants spécialisés), en lien avec le SPSTI.

Vous interviendrez dans une approche proactive : identification des entreprises à risque, propositions d’actions ciblées, et recherche d’impact mesurable.

  • 3 à 7 ans d’expérience en prévention des risques professionnels (ou expérience équivalente fortement appréciée).

  • Domaines de compétence appréciés : ergonomie, psychologie du travail, hygiène industrielle, conseil en prévention/HSE.

description:
🦊 À propos de Green-Got :

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) + Télétravail partiel Contrat : Alternance Niveau : Master 1 Poste à pourvoir : Janvier - Février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable.

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %)

  • Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus.

  • Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

  • Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait.

Outils et amélioration continue (20 %)

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement.

  • Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe.

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

  • Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout.

  • Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues.

  • Curiosité et débrouillardise : tu apprends vite, seul comme en équipe, et tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui change souvent.

title: CDI - Head of Finance (Paris)
description:
We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities.

It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales.

With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. As Matera grows, including through acquisitions in France and Germany, there is scope to rapidly grow into a VP Finance role.

What you will do

1. Operational finance and business plan (70%) :

  • Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks.

  • Own the annual budget, built with every team lead, and the business plan, updated every month after the close, for France and Germany.

  • Own cash: the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms.

  • Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee (garantie financière) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf (fonds mandants). You also cover the research tax credit (CIR) and tax.

2. Strategic topics (20%) :

  • Lead the finance team (4 people) and steer our external accountants and auditors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Prepare the board deck and investor materials with the CFO, including for our 2027 fundraise, and bring a clear finance view to strategic decisions: acquisitions, growth versus capacity, cash allocation, pricing.

  • Drive our finance tools roadmap: selecting and rolling out an ERP (planned for late 2027), billing and payment tools, and automating data and reporting.

  • Pick up whatever else lands on finance: supplier negotiations, legal structure of our entities, equity events.

3. M&A (10%) : work with the other teams on financial analyses, billing, and the integration of the companies we acquire.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • The monthly close and reporting pack land on a fixed calendar in both countries, without escalation

  • Audits in France and Germany are signed on time and on fee; every entity's accounts are filed on time

  • Garantie financière and fonds mandants obligations are met with no gaps

  • The rolling business plan is the single reference for decisions, refreshed every month after close

  • The weekly cash forecast is trusted by the CEO and the board; collection has improved measurably

  • Every finance deliverable has a clear owner, and the German close runs locally

  • The ERP is selected and its implementation is on plan

What we offer

Benefits

  • Parental support: a gradual return at 80% for 4 weeks (paid at 100%), plus 5 extra days off per year when your child is sick.

  • Responsible commute leave: 1 extra paid day off per year (can be split into two half-days) to encourage low-carbon commuting.

  • Menstrual leave: 1 extra paid day off per month to manage painful periods.

  • Sport: access to Wellpass for affordable gym and sports.

  • Works council perks (Leeto): discounts on culture and leisure (cinema, museums, theme parks…).

  • Remote work: 2 days a week at the office.

  • Career support: weekly one-to-ones with your manager, 2 performance reviews a year, and an internal mobility policy.

  • A laptop and a work phone.

Practical information

  • Location: Paris 10th

  • Contract: permanent contract (CDI), full-time, cadre status on a forfait jours basis

  • Salary: €90k to €100k base, depending on experience

  • Start date: before July 2027


What we are looking for

You must have:

  • 7+ years in finance, including at least 2 years owning the close and audits of a multi-entity company, for example as Head of Finance, Finance Manager or Senior Financial Controller.

  • Hands-on experience of closing the books and running statutory audits in France: you know the French system (social charges, tax, statutory auditors).

  • Experience in a group with entities in other countries (not necessarily Germany).

  • You build and defend financial models (P&L, cash, headcount, churn) and can run a monthly business plan yourself.

  • You have managed a small team, and you still like doing some of the work yourself.

  • Fluent French and English, written and spoken.

You are:

  • Direct: you say when a number does not hold, including to the CEO.

  • Hands-on and structured: you turn open questions into plans with owners and deadlines.

  • Firm with suppliers: you manage auditors, accountants and vendors on scope, calendar and fees.

  • Autonomous and comfortable with change: you have worked in a growing company that needed structure.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with a German subsidiary or parent company, or speaking German.

  • Experience of acquisitions and their integration.

  • Experience in a regulated environment or with client funds (real estate, property management, fintech).

  • Experience of selecting or rolling out an ERP.

Our hiring process

1️⃣ A 30-minute phone call with Camille, our recruiter

2️⃣ A technical discussion with Krystal, our CFO, and Valent, our current Head of Finance (45 min, video call)

3️⃣ A case study to prepare and present to the CFO and Head Of Finance (45 min, video call)

4️⃣ A meeting with Raphaël, our CEO, and the team, at our office (1h)

5️⃣ Reference checks, then an offer

Good to know:

🕑 We do our best to get back to you quickly (within a week). Whether the answer is yes or no, you will receive an email from us, so remember to check your spam folder.

☝️ If you need any adjustments to take part in the interviews in the best conditions, let us know in your application or tell the recruitment team.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The role 🔍

One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right.

You will own that problem. You will build the product that checks deliverables before they leave the building: numbers that match between the Excel model and the deck, totals that add up, sources and footnotes that are there, disclaimers that are complete, AI-generated text that says only what the data supports.

This is a Senior PM role (L3 on our career ladder). You frame the problem, not only the solution.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

You will join the Product team: 5 PMs, 2 product designers and 2 product marketing managers. You will work every day with a product designer and with your own engineering squad. You will report to Matteo, our Chief Product Officer.

How we work 🤖

We are an AI-first product team. We lead the move to AI tools across the whole company, and we hold ourselves to that standard first.

We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.

We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.

What this means for you:

  • Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

  • Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

  • Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.

Team goals 🎯

We run two workstreams: we keep improving the features thousands of financial professionals use every day, and we are building our new AI product. We launched our first AI product in April 2026 and we are rebuilding the full product around AI.

Verification is a core part of that bet. Financial firms will only let AI produce client work if they can trust the output. If we make trust measurable, we win the deals our competitors cannot.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Own the verification product (50%)

  • Run discovery with bankers, financial advisors, PE and asset management teams. Learn how they review a deck or a model today, what they miss, and what an error costs them.

  • Define what "verified" means for each type of deliverable: pitch deck, financial model, investment report.

  • Build and own the roadmap across 2 squads. Say no to good ideas to protect the important ones. Plan a quarter ahead and adjust.

  • Test prototypes on real client files before development starts.

Drive adoption and revenue (30%)

  • Define the tracking plan before launch. Run a monthly metrics review of your area.

  • Partner with Sales on key deals and with Product Marketing on launches.

  • Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

  • Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

  • Build the eval sets and guardrails for verification. Track false positives as closely as missed errors: a checker that cries wolf gets switched off.

  • Make the cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs with Engineering.

  • Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

You will work with Notion, Azure DevOps, Figma, Claude and, of course, PowerPoint, Excel and Word with UpSlide.

Your goals ⚡

After 3 months: you know our users and their deliverables. You have mapped the most common and most costly errors in decks, models and reports, from at least 15 client interviews. You have a first eval set and a prototype tested with clients.

After 6 months: the first verification checks are live with design partner clients. You can show their accuracy (errors caught, false alarms) and you have a roadmap for the next two quarters.

After 9 months: verification is a paid capability. It moves a metric the company tracks, for example paid AI adoption in a segment from X to Y accounts, or win rate against a named competitor.

At UpSlide we have a career path to help you grow. From Senior PM, you can move to Lead PM (individual contributor, owning a strategic bet across several squads) or Group PM (managing 2 to 4 PMs).


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Built or rolled out an AI product used by real customers. You have designed prompts and evals, made cost and latency trade-offs, and you know how to spot when the model is wrong. This is a must.

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, with a product area you owned end to end.

  • Taken an ambiguous problem, framed it, and turned it into a plan a team could execute.

  • Moved a business metric (revenue, retention, win rate) and can explain how your roadmap did it.

  • A habit of building with AI every day: prototypes, specs, data queries, interview synthesis.

  • Comfort with data: you define tracking plans and change priorities based on what usage shows.

  • Clear written English. Your updates are short, factual and easy to act on.

Hybrid work: 3 days a week in the office.

Location: Paris

We'd love it if:

  • You have worked as an investment banker or in financial advisory (M&A, valuation, transaction services). You have built pitch decks and financial models and lived through late-night review cycles.

  • You have worked on quality, review or compliance products (document review, audit, data validation).

  • You have sold to or worked with regulated financial firms and know their security and compliance demands.

  • You speak French.

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Intro call with Andréa (30 min): your background, your motivation, logistics.

  2. Interview with Matteo, CPO (45 min): the AI products you built or rolled out, what worked, what did not, and why.

  3. Case study with a PM, a product designer and an Engineering Manager (60 min).

  4. Cross-functional interview with Sales or Customer Success lead (45 min): how you work with GTM teams and with demanding clients.

  5. Final interview with Philippe, CEO (30 min): values and long-term fit.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

⚡ On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: French start-up with employees across Paris, London, Berlin, New York, and Singapore, as well as users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development:

  • Custom onboarding plan per role

  • Internal and external group training

  • Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events:

  • Annual seminars: a global seminar in France and a teaminar in your country

  • Office socials: monthly apéro, goûter every Thursday, breakfast every other Tuesday, and a Children’s Christmas party on top of the employees’ Christmas party, etc.

  • Group activities: weekly yoga classes, monthly karaoke sessions, an indoor rock-climbing group, and participation in solidarity walks

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT in 2026, with one taken for Solidarity Day

👩‍⚕️Health:

  • Health insurance (mutuelle) with Alan covered at 50% and available from your first day. You can extend coverage to your partner and children

  • Osteopathy sessions at the office, largely covered by UpSlide

🚆 Commute: Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • Flexible return to work options

  • Help for parents with children up to 6 years old: Either 4 days of fully paid sick-child leave, or, up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

🌳 Sustainability engagements:

  • Certified B-Corp since 2022, which means we not only care about profit, but also about people and the planet

More about UpSlide

  • On top of exciting business challenges in a fast-growing market, you will find a friendly, caring, and challenging culture

  • UpSlide employees have committed to making a positive impact on the world. We obtained B Corp certification in 2022 with strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. UpSlide is now 30% owned by employees. More info here: upslide.net/en/from-a-to-b-corp-our-mission-for-positive-impact/

This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you've joined UpSlide ✨

title: Senior Computational Biologist
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines.

What you'll do

  • You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation.

  • Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny.

  • Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data

  • You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality figures, panels and supporting narrative, extending to posters, presentations or manuscripts where relevant.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who's comfortable working on complex biological questions across different therapeutic areas and drug development programs. You will own analysis and interpretation. The ideal candidate is creative, driven, fast, rigorous and autonomous.

You will be tackling complex internal R&D subjects that are actively slowing down cancer research. Your findings will impact the field and your work is expected to reach leading scientists via international conferences and peer-reviewed papers.

Must have

  • PhD in Computational Biology, bioengineering or any related field, 2 to 3 years analyzing complex biological data in a research or biotech setting is a plus.

  • Strong experience with molecular data: You analyse omics data (transcriptomics, genomics) within the context of cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening…

  • Interdisciplinary mindset: You quickly understand the context and framework within teams outside of your area of expertise. You are comfortable working in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, lab-based scientists and engineers.

  • Structured communication: You communicate research findings clearly through well-documented code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations. For example, you can highlight key figures or publications where you drove the computational biology.

  • Real interest in cancer biology: You don't need to arrive as an expert: there's considerable depth around you and you'll absorb a great deal of it. But you should find the cancer biology genuinely interesting, and be the sort of person who goes the extra mile to understand what happens behind the result.

  • Strong programming skills: Python and fluency in the scientific coding stack.

  • Fluent in English: We are an interdisciplinary and multicultural team working in English.

Nice to have

  • Strong experience working with experimentalists.

  • Comfortable holding two or three analyses in parallel without losing track of either.

  • Experience in working with or analyzing data generated from sophisticated patient-derived cellular models (e.g. PDOs, PDXOs).

  • Industry experience where your analyses fed real go/no-go decisions.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be in a high-impact research role at the core of a distinctive oncology discovery platform, where you will have access to rare PDO multi-omics and functional datasets, and a dedicated engineering counterpart to turn your methods into durable building blocks.

  • Impact: participate and have ownership in a fast-growing, multi-faceted project at the early stage of a growing start-up, with the opportunity to shape it; a role where your technical expertise will have a tangible impact on patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster.

This is a role where you are expected to be in the lab, talk to scientists and lab technicians on a day-to-day basis. You will see how science is done in the lab, and then think hard about how to improve its impact. If you’re excited by complex workflows and the friction of real-life lab work, as well the power of data and AI, this position is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the lab-based data generation pipelines: to enable data transfer at scale from the lab to the cloud. This will involve building and improving production codebases that turn high-throughput experimental readouts into validated insights.

  • Facilitate lab operations : Maintain and/or build tools to accelerate the work of Orakl Oncology scientists.

  • Define and own the canonical data model: Design the unified data model that structures our data and is adopted across teams, ensuring data can be joined across modalities: experimental, clinical, omics, and clinical-trial event reporting.

  • Design and own data quality pipeline: Build QC that flags data quality at transfer time, and turn it into feedback loops so scientists can spot experimental errors early and integrate checks into their routine.

  • Support lab initiatives: such as automation initiatives, the development of experimental tooling to help lab scientists and technicians.

  • Drive operational efficiency: make sure that wet lab work is optimized to benefit the most from our resources (human and experimental) and ensure efficient contract and research delivery.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters or PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • 3+ years of experience as a data scientist, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining Python code in production

  • Strong hacker and tinkerer mindset. You like building things that have a real world effects.

  • Excellent proficiency in Python and SQL, and solid data-engineering skills: pipeline design and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or equivalent), version control (Git), testing/CI, and observability.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data-storage best practices.

  • Comfortable working with noisy, real-world experimental data and directly alongside non-technical scientists.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with experimental, assay, or high-throughput screening data.

  • Working knowledge of biology, ideally in oncology, cell biology, or drug discovery.

  • Experience with image analysis / computer vision applied to microscopy data.

  • Familiarity with lab data systems / LIMS (e.g. Benchling) and experimental workflows.

Who You Are

  • Curious and autonomous: you dig into scientists' bottlenecks, connect the dots across teams, and ship without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • A fast shipper: you get working solutions into production and iterate, rather than polishing in isolation.

  • A strong communicator: you gather needs from and explain your work to non-technical scientists, acting as the data bridge across the lab and beyond.

  • At ease in a complex and interdisciplinary environment: you thrive with messy data, evolving priorities, and external constraints that come with a science-first, non-pure-tech setting.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own the wet-lab data backbone of a techbio platform from the ground up: your work directly shapes how we discover and validate cancer therapies.

  • Sit at one of the most interdisciplinary intersections in techbio: data science, production engineering, and experimental oncology, side-by-side every day.

  • High autonomy and immediately visible impact, in a fast-growing, mission-driven company backed by leading investors.

Interview Process

  1. HR Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 65-person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries, growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

⚙️ The role

ScorePlay is the platform major sports organizations use to manage, search and share their media, from the second it's captured to the moment it reaches everyone's screen. A photographer uploads thousands of shots after the final whistle. A live feed has to be logged and clipped into highlights while the game is still being played. The right assets have to reach 10,000+ athletes, partners and newsrooms worldwide, automatically. At 145M+ minutes of video ingested every month and 15+ petabytes stored, much of the architecture needed at that scale simply hasn't been built before.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our product engineering teams. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and sit on the engineering leadership team.

This is a technical role. You'll need a deep understanding of how our systems work to prioritize well and propose the right technical solutions. Shipping code isn't your main priority, though. Your main priorities are building the environment that lets your team ship faster, the quality of its technical decisions, the people you grow, and the problems you solve before they become incidents. Understanding how everything works is a must. Shipping code is extra.

🔥 Why this is interesting

This is a rare chance to work where engineering meets sports. You'll help build a unique, state-of-the-art product whose engineering challenges come from data volume and latency. Content has to be ingested, processed, searched and distributed at petabyte scale, often while the match is still being played. When the whistle blows, the platform has to be fast, and it has to hold.

🧠 What you'll own

People

  • Manage and grow your team: regular one-on-ones, clear expectations, direct feedback, growth plans that mean something.

  • Handle performance head-on. Recognize what's great, address what isn't early and in writing, and see it through when it doesn't improve.

  • Hire with our talent acquisition team: define the profiles your team needs, run interviews, and onboard new engineers so they ship in their first weeks.

Technical direction

  • Own the quality of your team's technical decisions: review and challenge designs, requests for comments (RFCs) and estimates.

  • Drive foundational work from problem framing to production, and balance it against client commitments.

  • Own your team's reliability: incidents, debug complex issues, postmortems, on-call health, and technical debt that gets paid down, not just listed.

Product and speed

  • Run your team's delivery with your product manager as one small team that shares context instead of handing it off.

  • Make your team faster, every quarter. Take a feature that took twelve weeks and work out how it could have taken one: cut waste, automate what can be automated, and improve your processes.

  • Define what can be delegated to AI and what needs thorough design and review, and set the guardrails that keep that line clear.

  • Push back when a product decision doesn't hold up technically, and propose what would.

  • Work with clients' technical teams on integrations and enterprise workflows when it matters.

  • Be ready to get your hands dirty and go the extra mile. Sometimes it's all hands on deck, and that means you chip in too (and ship in).

Beyond your team

  • Prioritize topics that go beyond engineering, and work with stakeholders from other teams (product, sales, customer success, support) to move them forward.

  • Contribute to engineering leadership: how we plan, how we run incidents, how we make decisions.

🛠 The stack and how we work

Golang for services. PostgreSQL, Kafka, Temporal for workflows, OpenSearch, Kubernetes, all on AWS. We use AI heavily (but wisely), in the product and in how we work as engineers.

Small cross-functional teams own their scope from conception to production. Structural decisions go through RFCs. Every week, the whole engineering team gets together to present and debate technical subjects. Every incident gets a postmortem, with real numbers attached.

🧩 What we're looking for

  • 3+ years managing engineers as an Engineering Manager, after a solid run as a backend or platform engineer. You've managed underperformance to resolution, not only coached strong performers.

  • A real technical foundation in backend and distributed systems. You don't need to write Go every day, but you can read an RFC on a search index or a Kafka topology and spot what's wrong.

  • You've led a team through a significant architectural change while still delivering for customers.

  • Initiative beyond your scope: examples of problems you owned across teams without being asked.

  • Clear written communication. At ScorePlay, decisions are made in writing.

  • A builder first. You've managed and you understand management in depth, but your instinct is to build and simplify, not to add layers and complexity.

  • You've made a team measurably faster: shorter cycles, fewer hand-offs, more done by fewer people.

  • Bonus: experience in a scale-up with 10–50 engineers, or on video, media or storage-heavy products.

📍 The setup

Remote from Europe, remote-first with regular team gatherings, in an international team spread across Europe and the US.

On-call is part of the role. When our platform is down, matches are happening without us. As an Engineering Manager, you're on the escalation path: when an incident needs coordination, decisions or someone to pull in the right people, that's you. Every incident gets a written postmortem with cost and impact attached, so the same thing doesn't wake anyone up twice.

🏆 Why ScorePlay

  • Real scale, real stakes: 145M+ minutes of video a month, and the systems your team builds now become the foundations for years.

  • The product is technical to its core, and it's what clients pay for. Engineering leaders are in the room for business decisions.

  • No layers, no committees. A short line from you to the Head of Engineering and the founders.

  • Your team's work shows up on match day, used by clubs, leagues and athletes you might already follow.

  • An international team of 15+ nationalities across Europe and the US.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Compensation: $80K – $110K • $150K Equity

As the composite technician on the Airframe team, your core mission is to prototype carbon structures fast, in-house — from mould to finished, quality-checked part — and to bring innovative solutions that make assembly and prototyping easier. A true hands-on professional, you combine technical skills, initiative, and a maker mindset. You build tooling, lay up and finish composite parts (carbon / glass fibre), and turn the engineers' CAD into flight-worthy structures on short cycles. You are also the owner of technical drawings and supplier quotations for the parts you handle, and the one who trains production operators when a design moves to series. You thrive with minimal supervision, favour pragmatic, quick-result approaches over perfect-but-slow tooling, and are equally comfortable laying up a part, machining or printing a mould, and reading a technical drawing.

Technical skills

Key responsibilities

Rapid in-house prototyping (core)

  • Produce carbon prototype structures quickly in-house, choosing the fastest viable route rather than heavy tooling when a proto is the goal.

  • Propose innovative, simple solutions to speed up assembly and prototyping.

  • Design certain parts and prototyping tools yourself (fixtures, adapters, simple structural parts) when it is faster than going through the design loop.

  • Iterate fast with the design engineers: short loops between concept, part and feedback, flagging manufacturability issues before they cost a mould.

Tooling & moulds

  • Build and maintain moulds and tooling, in coordination with the design team; machine or 3D-print mould masters, prepare and polish mould surfaces.

  • Design and build layup jigs, trimming templates, bonding and assembly fixtures.

  • Manage the composite workshop consumables and material inventory (fabrics, resins, cores, vacuum consumables) including storage and shelf-life follow-up.

Design & documentation

  • Read and interpret 2D/3D drawings and ply books; model simple parts and tooling in CAD when needed; give manufacturability feedback early.

  • Own the technical drawings: produce and keep up to date the manufacturing drawings for the parts and tooling you handle.

  • Write and maintain clear, accessible fabrication procedures, ply books and cure logs on Confluence so processes are repeatable by others.

  • Optimise part designs for their manufacturing process: adapt geometries for plastic injection (wall thickness, draft angles, ribs) or for composite / 3D-printed fabrication (layup feasibility, demoulding, printability), in collaboration with the design engineers.

Support & improvement

  • Support assembly and mechanical testing, including preparing test coupons and samples for structural analysis.

  • Identify and propose process and quality improvements; help run the composite workshop safely (dust extraction, PPE, resin handling and waste management).

  • Own the knowledge transfer to production: train the production operators on fabrication and assembly processes, and validate that a process is repeatable by others before handover.

Candidate profile

  • Technical diploma or degree in composite materials, mechanical / aerospace manufacturing, industrial technology, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proven experience in rapid in-house composite prototyping (carbon / glass fibre): hand layup, vacuum bagging, infusion and/or prepreg; mould making and surface preparation a strong plus.

  • Track record of quick, pragmatic solutions — getting a functional carbon part out fast, with sound trade-offs, rather than perfect parts requiring heavy tooling.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and ply books, and to control layup orientation, resin ratios, debulking and cure cycles with rigour and traceability.

  • Ability to produce manufacturing drawings (2D plans)

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacturing basics for plastic injection (wall thickness, draft angles) and composite / 3D-printed parts, to optimise geometries with the design engineers.

  • Hands-on finishing skills: trimming, sanding, drilling composites, structural bonding, insert fitting, and basic defect detection (porosity, delamination).

  • Proficiency with common fabrication tools (hand tools, bench equipment, 3D printer; basic machining appreciated); CAD literacy (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, FreeCAD or similar) to adapt tooling and jigs.

  • Highly autonomous — able to take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion with minimal supervision; resourceful and solution-oriented, comfortable improvising with available means.

  • Pedagogy and communication: able to write clear, accessible procedures and to train production operators so processes remain repeatable without you; rigorous on process, safety and documentation.

  • Experience working closely with sales in a B2B, enterprise, or deep-tech sales motion. GNSS experience appreciated but not required.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

  • Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

  • No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

  • Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.
