title: Project Director, Digital Promise Networks
description:
About Digital Promise Global

Digital Promise is a global nonprofit working to expand opportunity for every learner. We work with educators, researchers, technology leaders, and communities to design, investigate, and scale innovations that support learners. Our vision is that every person engages in powerful learning experiences that lead to a life of well-being, fulfillment, and economic mobility. For more information, visit the Digital Promise website and follow Digital Promise for updates.

About the Position

Term: Limited-term, project-based position for 2 years, funded through a strategic partnership. Extension is possible.

Digital Promise Global seeks an experienced project manager to serve as Project Director, Digital Promise Networks, overseeing a two-year national K-12 initiative that helps educators build confidence and skills with AI and managing recruitment for the League of Innovative Schools.

This is a full-time, remote, two-year limited-term position, with the possibility of extension. Your time will be split primarily between two areas of work:

  • K-12 AI Educator Initiative (about 70%): You will manage a multi-partner national project, keeping work on schedule, holding partners to deliverables, and engaging educators at scale.
  • League Recruitment and Network Support (about 25%): You will lead recruitment and onboarding of new League districts and support other League programming
  • Educator Networks (5%): You will collaborate with otherDigital Promise network initiatives and contribute to team-wide priorities.

Is this role right for you? This is a hands-on project leadership role. Day-to-day, you will build and run timelines, manage partners to deliverables, track data, solve problems as they come up, and report to a funding partner. You will also shape and carry out the strategy for recruiting school districts into a national network, from identifying potential members through onboarding. This role is a strong fit for someone who has independently managed complex education projects from start to finish and who is comfortable building relationships with district and state education leaders.

Responsibilities

K-12 AI Educator Initiative Project Management (~70%)

Planning and Execution

  • Own the project plan, timeline, and deliverables from launch through close, setting milestones, assigning tasks, and tracking progress to meet deadlines and quality standards.
  • Oversee day-to-day project operations, including team schedules, communication channels, and logistics for internal meetings and external convening.
  • Identify bottlenecks, risks, and unexpected issues early, and work with internal colleagues and partners to resolve them.
  • Apply a continuous improvement lens to improve systems and processes.

Partner and Educator Engagement

  • Manage subgrantee and implementation partner relationships, including scopes of work, regular check-ins, and shared deliverables.
  • Oversee educator engagement, including broad outreach campaigns, curated learning pathways, and state-based educator cohorts.
  • Manage cross-functional teams and partners to solve problems, strategize around project interdependencies, and collaborate to determine a clear path forward.
  • Coordinate with the K-12 research team to ensure coherence between implementation and research and a seamless experience for educators.

Reporting and Documentation

  • Own overall project communications, including regular reports to stakeholders and funders to convey progress toward goals and surface insights and lessons.
  • Coordinate with Digital Promise communications colleagues on project announcements and the timely release of resources.
  • Track participation and outcome data, and use it to adjust the work and keep it on course.
  • Maintain clear project documentation for internal teams, external partners, and funder reporting requirements.

League Member Recruitment and Network Support (~25%)

  • Develop and lead the League's recruitment strategy, including goals, target audiences, timelines, and outreach approaches.
  • Identify and research potential member districts and leaders who align with the League's mission and would strengthen the network.
  • Manage outreach to prospective League districts and leaders, and coordinate the application, review, and selection process.
  • Create a welcoming onboarding experience that helps new members connect with peers, resources, and opportunities.
  • Gather and use applicant and member feedback to improve recruitment and onboarding.
  • Support League programming, including member calls, learning experiences, and convenings.
  • Contribute to Digital Promise network initiatives that connect League members to relevant work across the organization.

Educator Networks (5%)

  • Support collaboration across educator networks and programs
  • Contribute to a healthy team culture by supporting cross-team priorities
  • Connect with colleagues in other Digital Promise initiatives to share best practices

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in education, public policy, nonprofit management, business, communications, or a related field.
  • At least 7 years of experience working in or with K-12 education (for example, as an educator, school or district leader, or at an organization that serves K-12 schools).
  • 4-7 years of project or program management experience. This experience may overlap with your K-12 experience.
  • Experience leading multi-partner, cross-organizational projects from planning through completion, including managing external partners, subgrantees, or vendors to agreed-upon deliverables and deadlines
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, as well as Google Workspace and Zoom, and comfort using AI tools in your own work.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree.
  • Experience working with state education agencies or education service agencies.
  • Experience managing professional learning programs, cohorts, or learning communities for educators
  • Deep familiarity with how AI is being used in K-12 teaching and learning.
  • Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM.

Skills and Attributes

  • Highly organized, with a track record of managing multiple priorities and following through on details.
  • A relationship-builder who earns the trust of superintendents, state leaders, and partners.
  • A clear, concise writer and communicator.
  • A skilled facilitator and active listener.
  • Comfortable using data to make decisions and track progress.
  • Works independently, uses sound judgment, and is comfortable with ambiguity.

At Digital Promise, we also seek candidates with:

  • A strong commitment to working toward Digital Promise’s mission and impact goals
  • An interest in redesigning learning systems to better serve those who are historically and systemically excluded
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional team members to ensure information is shared, projects are completed on time, and goals are reached.

Working Conditions

Digital Promise Global is a hybrid organization. The position is primarily working in a remote environment. Employees are expected to travel at least 4 times a year for in-person meetings and the annual staff retreat. Additional travel may be required based on role and responsibilities.

Physical/Sensory Demands:Fast-paced working environment. Extensive computer usage and online engagement & communication. Must be willing to build inclusive relationships and collaborate with employees at all levels within the organization and external partners.

Compensation

We consider candidate experience and location when determining where a candidate may fall within that range. Digital Promise Global offers a competitive total rewards package including coverage of 85% of health insurance premiums for employee coverage and 75% of health insurance premiums for dependent and family coverage, 15 vacation days, 12 sick days, 3% 401k employer contribution, 3% employer 401k match, and a flexible work environment.

The full-time salary range for the position is based on geographical regions, with exact salary depending on relevant experience.

California:$132,821-$156,261

DC Metro Area & NYC:$120,747-$142,055

National:$108,672-$127,850

To Apply

Please apply and submit your resume, cover letter, and salary requirements. Applicants are encouraged to submit their materials as soon as possible. Submissions are reviewed on a rolling basis until the search is successful.

Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

title: Incident Response, Team Lead
description:
Description

About Sygnia
Sygnia is a leading global cyber readiness and incident response firm. Our teams operate on the digital frontlines of today’s most sophisticated cyber battles, helping the world’s top organizations withstand and recover from complex attacks, often in high-pressure, high-stakes environments. We combine technical excellence, elite talent, and battle-tested methodologies to help our clients build resilience and respond with confidence.

Sygnia is rapidly expanding its presence in the United States, growing our incident response capabilities and client base across key industries. Joining now means playing a formative role in shaping our U.S. operations while benefiting from the backing and expertise of an established global leader.

The Role
We’re seeking a highly technical and client-facing Incident Response Team Lead to spearhead incident response engagements and guide a small team of Incident Response Experts through some of the most challenging investigations in the industry. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the trenches conducting deep technical investigations, leading response efforts, and serving as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 security teams.

As a Team Lead, you will manage 2–5 direct reports, contribute hands-on to forensic and incident response work, and play a key role in building and refining our internal processes, tools, and methodologies. You’ll face ransomware and advanced threat actors head-on, helping our clients recover and emerge more secure than before.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead incident response investigations across a wide range of attack types, supporting organizations through both immediate response and longer-term remediation efforts.
  • Serve as the primary technical and advisory point of contact for internal and external security and IT teams.
  • Manage and mentor a small team of elite incident responders, supporting their growth and ensuring operational excellence.
  • Perform hands-on forensic analysis of systems, networks, and logs to identify indicators of compromise, persistence mechanisms, and lateral movement.
  • Leverage Sygnia’s internal tools and methodologies to guide containment, eradication, and recovery efforts.
  • Support threat hunting activities during and after engagements to identify residual attacker presence or undiscovered impact.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Sygnia’s IR playbooks, detection and investigation processes, and internal tools.
  • Help scope new engagements, balancing client urgency with technical feasibility and team bandwidth.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience leading technical teams, with the ability to motivate, guide, and develop junior and mid-level talent.
  • Strong, demonstrable expertise in incident response, digital forensics, and malware or threat analysis.
  • Hands-on skills in analyzing host-based artifacts (Windows, Linux, macOS), log data, network captures, and disk/memory images.
  • Familiarity with attacker tradecraft, including lateral movement, privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and ransomware operations.
  • Experience working with enterprise environments and interacting directly with clients in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong communication skills, able to explain complex findings to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of cloud forensics (AWS, Azure, GCP) or EDR platforms is a plus.
  • Ability to travel as needed (~25%) based on client engagements, sometimes with limited notice.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry-recognized certifications (e.g., GCFA, GCIH, GNFA, GCIA, GREM, CISSP).
  • Experience responding to ransomware, business email compromise (BEC), and advanced threat actor incidents.
  • Experience presenting findings to legal counsel, regulators, or board-level stakeholders.
  • Multilingual skills and experience in multinational or cross-cultural environments.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; or equivalent education or training in cybersecurity

Why Sygnia

  • Work with some of the best minds in cybersecurity on the world’s most high-impact cases.
  • Operate in a fast-paced, elite-tier environment where your technical expertise is trusted and valued.
  • Take part in meaningful, challenging work that directly shapes the outcomes for Fortune 500 organizations.
  • Grow your career while staying hands-on in incident response and mentoring a highly capable team.

Product Presentation: Present and explain our product features and benefits to customers, using technical knowledge to demonstrate how our products meet their needs. ​

Channel Alignment: Engage with both national and regional channel partners to leverage their exposure and resources to earn share in the market.

Collaboration: Team up with inside sales, product management, and other departments to develop winning sales strategies, improve product offerings, and deliver above-quota growth.

Bachelor’s degree in related field required

Proven track record of exceeding sales objectives.

Deep understanding of industry standards and regulations, including UL, IEEE, NEC, and IEC.

Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.

In-depth knowledge of customer and market dynamics.

Exceptional ability to prospect, qualify, and close new customers.

A creative and curious mind that thrives on asking questions to uncover solutions.

Strong interpersonal skills, enabling the ability to build and maintain meaningful relationships.

Self-motivated and capable of working independently, as well as collaboratively within a team.

Possess a hunter mentality with a competitive drive to dominate the marketplace.

Results-driven with a relentless sense of urgency.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
About Hedgerow Software:

Hedgerow provides cloud-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission-driven company, we are committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good. We seek team members who take pride in their work and consistently improve their skills and knowledge.

This role will focus on Hedgerow, GovPilot's environmental health software solution, which helps public health and environmental agencies streamline inspections, permitting, and compliance to protect the communities they serve.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Professional development opportunities and learning budget.
  • Supportive team environment.
  • The chance to work on innovative projects with cutting-edge technologies.

About the Role

The Implementation Analyst, part of the Hedgerow Software Professional Services team, supports end-to-end deployments of our SaaS application for public health and environmental agencies. Working alongside the Project Manager, you’ll guide customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. Acting as both a project contributor and product expert, you’ll collaborate closely with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective, scalable system solutions.

You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from Hedgerow while receiving a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience. You’ll help clients rethink their business processes to get the most from the platform, and you’ll use AI tools to make implementations faster and more effective.

Key Requirements

  • Support the Project Manager in executing the implementation process for new Hedgerow customers, from kickoff through go-live.
  • Analyze and understand each customer’s business processes and apply best practices to guide how those processes translate into Hedgerow.
  • Become a product expert to configure the platform to match each agency’s specific workflows, data, and compliance requirements.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles required.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or other implementation-related platforms required.
  • Create custom reports using Hedgerow’s report writing tool, which often involves complex SQL stored procedures.
  • Train customer teams (inspectors, administrators, and staff) on how to use Hedgerow.
  • Identify and troubleshoot technical or process issues that arise during setup, escalating to the Project Manager as needed.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, data mapping, and configuration work, and help identify where AI can improve implementation speed and quality.
  • Document implementation processes and contribute to internal playbooks to improve future onboarding.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in implementation or onboarding of SaaS solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
  • Comfort working with data, including understanding data structures, interpreting datasets, and validating accuracy across systems
  • Working knowledge of SQL (queries and report writing across relational databases)
  • Comfort using AI tools (such as Claude or similar) to speed up data analyses, documentation, and configuration work
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical government staff
  • Proficiency with tools like HubSpot, or similar CRM/project management platforms
  • A problem-solving mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience in Gov-Tech SaaS, public health, environmental health, or a related sector
  • Experience implementing SaaS solutions for local governments or public health/environmental agencies
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve workflow efficiency (e.g., data transformation scripts, documentation generation, process automation).
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and driven to see a project through to a successful launch.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager of Professional Services | EH
  • Location: Remote (Canada)
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Salary Range: $90,000-$120,000 CAD. May be considered for a discretionary bonus
  • Status: Full Time
  • Please note: GovPilot is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Application Process

  1. Screening call with a recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview
  3. Technical/Team Panel Interview
  4. VP of CX Interview
  5. Final Interview with GovPilot CEO
  6. Reference Checks

How to Apply

If you are passionate about technology and eager to work on a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter today!

GovPilot is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. It's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and by providing this data, if you choose to, it will help us to stay accountable.

Requirements:

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
